method: Asset totals include all products, not simultaneous on-screen GPU passes. Draw submissions include scene instances. Texture memory is an RGBA8 plus mipmaps estimate. MiB = 1048576 bytes; transfer MB = 1000000 bytes.

posters.source: Actual geometry rendered with the website shared frame, camera pose and material overrides. Comparisons and hashes in showcase-poster-report.json.

qualityDecisions: Preserve both overlapping colored/dark Wera grip layers where independent decimation produced visible intersections. Reviewed low budgets for Kraftform XXL, Kraftform Kompakt 20 and Zyklop Speed are explicit in the recipe.
Tighter M750 low-LOD error and normal weights preserve the shell and grooves.
Remove only reviewed microscopic Wera framing markers and the ERGO shadow plane; normalize new product frames without changing source coordinates.
Watch triangles, textures and named glass override are unchanged; compatible meshes are joined.
Existing surface maps are reused; newly removed polygon detail is not automatically baked into textures.
Remove imported scene lights and cameras while retaining parent transforms and geometry. Shared Stage lighting stays constant as products enter the viewport, avoiding global shader recompilation.

websiteAssets.scope: apps/website/static/assets, excluding generated procedural demo assets; includes models, photos, posters, environment and decoders

photographs.details: Four smaller photographs reuse the full image as their thumbnail; exact bytes and provenance are recorded in showcase-media-report.json.
